s: Which of the following spiritual doctrine was propagated by Kumarila Bhatta?
x:
Kumarila Bhatta was one of the greatest philosophers of Purva Mimamsa, a school of Hindu philosophy that emphasized the authority of the Vedas and the importance of Vedic rituals (Karma Kanda). He strongly opposed Buddhist philosophical doctrines and defended the supremacy of Vedic religion through his scholarly works and debates. His contributions greatly influenced later Hindu philosophy and helped revive Vedic traditions in early medieval India.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (2).

s: Which philosophical theory was propagated by Kumarila Bhattu?
x:
Kumarila Bhatta was one of the greatest exponents of the Purva Mimamsa school of Hindu philosophy. He strongly defended the authority of the Vedas, the performance of Vedic rituals (Karma Kanda) and opposed Buddhist doctrines. His philosophical works, such as Slokavartika and Tantravartika, revived Vedic orthodoxy in India and greatly influenced later Hindu philosophy.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (1).
